method: Bounded original-CIL control flow replay, never original DLL execution. Native STO constructors are AST-building sinks preserving operator/member/argument data; collections/empty checks and expression values are controlled. The 12 real ASTs use explicitly controlled geometry, independent numeric intervals, and the shipped action.js false-condition gate; no JS generator/browser execution or actual rendered geometry claim.

results.name: ordered AND clamp combines lower and upper bounds with one original direction seed
OR flatten retains source-order leaves in STO projection; original boolean expression is a separate writer
null boundary clears scratch scope and returns null
empty unsupported comparison op has no synthesized clamp
